extension.summary: Rivulet: watch Stremio-protocol catalogs, addons and streams in Kodi
extension.description: Rivulet is a Kodi client for the Stremio addon protocol: browse and search catalogs by type, install community Stremio addons from a manifest URL, resolve streams and play them back through an embedded or remote rivulet-engine streaming server, and optionally sync your addon collection with your Stremio account.
extension.disclaimer: This addon does not host, index or provide any media content. It is a client for third-party Stremio addons that you install yourself.
extension.news: v0.47.0: - Changed: cast, crew and genre links open the same coverflow as Home's lists, titled with the name, with Search's details and poster reflections. - New: Search searches as you type, a moment after the last key; Enter is no longer needed. - Changed: Settings reorganised into labelled groups with help on every option; options that do nothing in the current setup are greyed out, API keys and passwords are masked, and number fields have real limits. - Fix: a ratings key paired with your phone is used right away and no longer wiped by the next Settings OK. - Fix: playback progress is saved every few seconds and on pause or seek, so short sessions and external servers resume where you stopped. - Fix: Brazilian Portuguese, Greek and Czech subtitles are found when you pick that language. - Fix: Rivulet screens stay visible when reopened over a video playing in a window. - Fix: a disabled Stream4Me or YouTube add-on is no longer treated as installed; trailers offer to enable YouTube. - Fix: the Kodi buffer settings install now matches your Kodi version (Kodi 21+ keeps its cache in Settings > Services > Caching). - Changed: smaller images on detail, source and showcase pages; long titles without a poster wrap.
